info.name: Flavor - Web Routes
info.description:
Flavor is a session authenticated, server rendered application. There is no JSON API.

How to use this collection:
1. Set base_url to your application URL, for example http://localhost:8000.
2. Run 'Load sign in page' first. Its test script extracts the CSRF token into the csrf_token variable.
3. Run 'Sign in'. Postman's cookie jar keeps the session cookie for every request that follows.
4. Re-run 'Load sign in page' whenever a request returns 419, which means the token expired.

Every mutating request sends x-www-form-urlencoded data with a _token field. PUT, PATCH and DELETE are sent as POST with a _method override, matching how the HTML forms submit.
